annotations.text: Superadmin console, matched to the app: Mona Sans / Hubot Sans, zinc tokens, brand blue, sharp corners, 56 px header, 32 px controls. Left rail replaces the second tab row. Static mockups; numbers are examples.

Navigation: rail → area list → detail. Owners list is the way into any person or team; its detail has "Open as <owner>" which opens their normal product pages. Header search is scoped to owners, nodes and requests inside superadmin. Back to the product: the kloudlite logo.
